Scope: sewage, storm water (to the ponds), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV medium-voltage cables, street lighting, telecom ducts and cables, internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks, the potable water and TSE pump stations, three lift stations and a mosque. Contract value SAR 560 million excluding VAT, 36 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-days (the labour units of the P6 schedule, 159,298 man-days). This week the MODON weekly report workbook was uploaded with the P6 update of 16-Nov-2026. The workbook states 57.58% against 55.11% planned, but its potable water network row carries an extra 4,248.78 man-days entered this week. Without that entry its own rows give 54.92%, the same figure computed from the P6 update, which is used here: 54.92% actual against 55.11% planned, 0.20% behind, SPI 1.00. The project gained 0.81% this week against 0.54% planned.

Slightly behind plan, and the P6 update still finishes 6 days late, now through the potable water pump station. The 16-Nov-2026 update finishes the project on 21-Mar-2028 against the contract date of 15-Mar-2028, as last week. The critical path has moved: 74 of the 75 open zero-float activities are now in the potable water pump station, whose finish slipped from 14 to 21-Mar-2028, while the TSE pump station gained 7 days (14-Mar-2028). This week's gain came from roads (578 man-days), street lighting (239), the electrical network (162), the TSE pump station (160) and earthworks for roads (97). The potable water and irrigation networks, landscape, the Jeddah-Jizan link road and the mosque earned nothing, and the sewage, storm and TSE network finishes moved another 7 days. Roads (40.2% against 57.8%), street lighting (44.3% against 72.6%) and landscape (0% against 17.1%) remain the weakest areas.

Method: each activity is weighted by its labour units in the revised baseline (009-RVSD03-REV02-1); actual progress uses each activity's physical % complete in the update, and planned progress spreads the units evenly between the baseline start and finish. For 16-Nov-2026 this gives 54.92% actual and 55.11% planned, matching the weekly report's planned value and every one of its phase rows except the potable water network. Its submitted 57.58% includes 4,248.78 man-days booked to that network this week, the same number as its October figure in the Physical-Chart Data sheet; it is not used.

The critical path moved to the potable water pump station, and the networks slipped another week. The potable water pump station finish moved 7 days to 21-Mar-2028 and lost its float; the TSE pump station moved back to 14-Mar-2028 with 6 days of float. Almost every interim milestone moved 7 days in a week, as in the two previous weeks. The weekly report's milestone sheet still shows road works 16-Jan-2026, deep works 16-Sep-2026 and MV works 19-Nov-2026 with "0 days change", which the schedule does not support. Float on interim milestones is measured to project finish.

Data notes

  • Basis: the weekly report workbook (1.wpr.xlsx, data date 16-Nov-2026) states 57.58% physical progress against 55.11% planned (SPI 1.04) and 3.48% earned this week. Its potable water network row has 4,248.78 man-days earned this week, taking it to 11,443 of 9,386 budgeted (121.92%); the P6 update shows no progress there. Without that entry the workbook's rows give 54.92%, equal to the P6 computation, which this report uses. Last week's report had no workbook and used the same P6 method (54.11%).
  • The Physical-Chart Data and Manpower sheets now give October 4,248.78 man-days (514 in the 02-Nov-2026 workbook) and a cumulative actual of 55.76% for October and 57.58% for November, which include the same figure. The chart keeps last week's actual points. The workbook also reports cost-based progress labelled "Earn Value", and its Conclusion sheet labels cost-based percentages as planned and actual progress; neither is used here.
  • The P6 update has a data date of 16-Nov-2026, but its latest actual start or finish is 09-Nov-2026, although 1,287 man-days were earned since 09-Nov.
  • The milestone sheet keeps road works 16-Jan-2026, deep works 16-Sep-2026 and MV works 19-Nov-2026 with "0 days change", and site handover 16-May-2025 (baseline) against 16-Mar-2025 in the General Information sheet. The safety plan approval date is entered as 05-May-2028. The HSE inspection names Eng. Hussam Mohamed as MODON PM; the workbook names Ahmed Alkutbi.
  • The summary labels 277,773,437 SAR, the net amount including VAT, as "Submitted invoices (gross value)" and as approved, while the log's gross total is 268,959,842, so approved exceeds submitted. The resource table still gives 6,329 actual against 1,703.5 planned manual head count, unchanged since 02-Nov-2026 (6,329 is September's man-day total).
  • Delivered quantities differ between files: MV cables 95,072 of 101,512 m in the procurement tracker but 189,522 of 189,522 m in the weekly report; LV cables 145,559 of 157,552 m against 78,945 of 78,945 m; lighting poles 1,249 of 1,322 against 1,161 of 1,161. The tracker shows potable water pipes delivered (32,471 m) above the contract quantity (32,438 m), and its data date (17-Nov-2026) is after the report's. Its safety score is 0.73 against 0.71 in the workbook.
  • The workbook's Weekly Photos sheet still carries last week's captions (electrical works, Logistic Area, TSE station mechanical works); this week's photos were taken from the uploaded image files. The workbook counts 3,800 shop drawings, of which 255 are coded D; last week's shop drawing log gave 3,551.
